Review PASS: no blocking findings; existing source-pattern tests now follow helper wiring and assert dictionary normalization behavior. Canonical notes: @doc/architecture/goals-tracking. System Decision Impact: none — removes synthetic fallback debt under existing evidence-based state semantics. Spec Decision Compliance: not applicable — standalone migration follow-up.
